description: This Java source file defines the custom exception class PoliciesConflictingException used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It signals conflicts related to policies in a 'Thing' object—specifically when both inline policies and policy references are provided simultaneously. The class includes builder patterns, static factory methods, and metadata annotations, and extends a runtime exception while implementing a Thing-specific exception interface.
